title: Kition Data Document Replica
description: A .kitable file's KDM replica for co-editing: POST /v1/data-documents/replica/version, POST /v1/data-documents/replica/export, POST /v1/data-documents/replica/import, and POST /v1/data-documents/replica/create (a new file from another copy's full export, answered like version), each naming the document by its workspace-relative path; and the table/replica-changed notification on the kit bridge stream (GET /v1/kits/bridge), sent after every local transaction (any origin but import) moves a file's replica to a new version. Bytes (versions and changes) are standard base64. An import has the origin import:sync: it is no undo step, it is stored and projected like any write, and it is published as table/changed (table-changed.schema.json) when it changed anything.

bytes.description: Standard base64; the empty string is no bytes.

workspace_root.description: The workspace the path is in; the runtime's when blank.

since.description: The version the caller holds; blank or missing exports every change.

path.description: Workspace-relative path of the new .kitable file; nothing may exist there yet (409).

workspace_root.description: The workspace the path is in; the runtime's when blank.

changes.description: A full export (replica/export from nothing) of another copy of the document: the new file holds that same document (same docId), with no undo steps. The answer is a versionResponse.

documentId.description: The data document's id, as in table/changed.

docId.description: The KDM document id: the same in every copy of the document, so it names its sync room.

version.description: The replica's version after the request.

change.description: What the import projected, with origin import:sync; empty when every change was known already.
